content.text: Note "wholsale" typo in the data; I'll check after copying.
The copy didn't happen (the earlier command was denied before running). Redoing it.

I copied `inbox/2025-12.csv` into `data/` and committed it as `be43ae1` with the message `2025-12: add rows`. `scripts/check.sh` printed OK before the commit.

The file has one row, R2512-003, with the category `wholsale`. `data/2025-11.csv` spells it `wholesale` (8 rows). The check only counts fields per row, so it didn't flag the typo. I committed the file unchanged because you asked me to add it as it is. If you want it corrected, it's a one-word fix in that row, but the source in `inbox/` would still have the typo.

I only grepped for that one spelling. I didn't check the other category values or the rest of the file.
